deadEnd.details: Ecwid Instant Site whose only gateway is PayPal — the run reaches the payment surface (level `cart`) and no guest card frame mounts. Live-classified paypal-only by the bench on 2026-07-20.

notes: First Ecwid store driven end-to-end. Useful as the platform's bench anchor precisely because the refusal is correct and reproducible: it exercises Ecwid detection + add-to-cart + checkout before classifying.
